description: Search wiki pages visible to this token by free text: by words in any form and by meaning (where the server has its embedding model), and literally — the title, the body, the labels written on an attached SVG diagram. Best match first; `match` says what found each page. `files` are PDF and Word files attached to pages, found by the words inside them. Optionally restrict to one space key. Without `text`, the pages most recently updated first.

label.description: Only pages carrying this label (list_wiki_labels names a space's labels). With `text`, the labelled pages that say it; without, all of them, most recently updated first.

text.description: What to look for, in your own words.

name: search_wiki
